full_text_zh:
[P1] 恐龙小Q 培养好习惯，做最好的自己。
超级
细菌王国
从小讲卫生
恐龙小Q儿童教育中心 编
中国人口出版社
全国百佳出版单位

[P2] “好困呀，我得睡觉了……”贝利吃了很多甜点后，他困极了，倒头就睡着了。

贝利肯定不知道，就在他的手上，一支细菌部队已经开始安营扎寨，准备建造一个超级细菌王国。

[P3] “食指上方发现点心碎屑！食指上方发现点心碎屑！”细菌指挥中心尖叫着发出指令。一列细菌小分队连忙赶到那里，它们用锤子、铲子把点心碎屑弄成小块，搬到车上——这可是他们建造房子的最好原料。

[P4] “大拇指下方发现一大团奶油！大拇指下方发现一大团奶油！”
细菌指挥中心又发出了指令。

细菌小分队连忙赶到了大拇指上，它们用铲子把奶油一点点铲下来，然后把奶油和一种液体搅和在一起，装到一个大桶里搬上车。

这种神奇的液体是最好的建筑防水材料。

[P5] “小拇指指缝发现砂糖！小拇指指缝发现砂糖！”细菌指挥中心再一次发出指令。
细菌小分队又迅速跑到小拇指上。这里有好多从饼干上掉下来的砂糖。
砂糖太硬了，细菌们必须先用破碎机把它们打碎才能搬上车。
对于细菌们来说，砂糖珍贵极了，它既可以给小细菌们补充能量，又是建造房子的特殊材料。当然，有的小细菌还会把它一粒粒串起来当项链戴在脖子上，饿了可以吃上一口。

[P6] 瞧，饼干电影院也快盖好了啦！
“嘿呦嘿！嘿呦嘿！”
小细菌们都非常勤快，他们挥舞着
锤子、铁锹使劲儿干。

贝利手上好多深浅不一的细纹，它们可是
细菌们的高速公路。
材料收集得差不多啦！细菌们把这些点心
碎屑、奶油、饼干渣、砂糖和各种脏东西运送
到他们的大本营里，然后开始敲敲打打，盖出
各式各样的房子。

[P7] 就在这时候，大雨哗啦啦地下来了。
“呀，贝利在洗手呢！”一个小细菌嚷嚷起来。
“没关系，大家赶快躲起来！”另一个小细菌说。
细菌们赶紧躲到了贝利的手指缝或指甲缝里。贝利从来都不认真清洗那些地方，也不爱剪指甲，躲在里面非常安全。

不一会儿雨就停了，虽然冲走了些盖房子的原料，但细菌们都还好好的。
瞧瞧，小细菌们盖的房子也都好好的，因为小细菌们给每个房子都做了防水处理。
“幸好贝利不爱洗手，真是太棒啦！”
小细菌们最爱他这一点。

[P8] 细菌国王挠着脑袋想了几个晚上，终于有了一个大胆的计划：把家搬到贝利的肚子里！
贝利的肚子里温暖、潮湿又宽敞，最适合细菌们居住啦！
小细菌们在贝利的手上吃得很饱，住得也很舒服，数量越来越多，简直都要住不下啦！

[P9] 说干就干！细菌们花了很长的时间，用砂糖做了个超硬、超大、超快的卡车，它一次能坐很多小细菌！
当贝利张开嘴巴吃面包时，细菌们瞅准机会，开着卡车顺利地从贝利的食指尖进入了他的嘴巴，并沿着食道滑进了贝利的肚子里。

[P10] 可是，这个晚会可把贝利害惨了，瞧，他的肚子疼得要命，妈妈也急得不知如何是好。

“呦吼！成功啦！”细菌们欢呼雀跃。
“这个地方可真好，我们来开个狂欢晚会怎么样？”一个小细菌提议说。
“好啊！太棒了！”大家纷纷表示支持。
细菌们在贝利的肚子里蹦啊、跳啊、喝啊，胡乱地折腾着，开心得不得了。

[P11] 正当细菌们玩得高兴时，一个大药片儿掉进贝利的胃里，它散发出来的怪味儿把小细菌们熏得够呛，它们乱作一团，拼命跑啊、逃啊！

更糟糕的是，建在贝利手上的细菌王国也受到了攻击。

“救命啊！”，
“怎么回事！贝利怎么还在洗手啊！”，
“这些是什么啊！”，

大雨下个不停，手指缝和指甲缝里全是水和泡沫，细菌们根本没处躲藏，最后，细菌和他们的房子一起被冲进了下水道。

超级细菌王国被消灭了。

[P12] 现在，贝利每天上完厕所、饭前饭后或者回到家后的第一件事就是把手洗干净——他可不希望再有小细菌在他手上建什么超级细菌王国了！

原来，医生把小细菌们在贝利手上建房子的事情告诉了他，还给他吃了药，让他认真洗了手。
full_text_en:
[P1] Dinosaur Q: Cultivate good habits, be the best version of yourself.
Super
Bacteria Kingdom
Start practicing hygiene from a young age
Compiled by Dinosaur Q Children's Education Center
China Population Publishing House
National Top 100 Publishing Houses

[P2] "I'm so sleepy, I need to go to sleep..." After eating a lot of desserts, Billy was extremely tired and fell asleep immediately.

Billy certainly didn't know that on his hand, a bacterial army had already begun to set up camp, preparing to build a super bacteria kingdom.

[P3] "Snack crumbs discovered above the index finger! Snack crumbs discovered above the index finger!" the bacteria command center screamed out the order. A squad of bacteria hurried to the spot, using hammers and shovels to break the snack crumbs into small pieces and load them onto the truck—this was the best material for building their houses.

[P4] "A big lump of cream found below the thumb! A big lump of cream found below the thumb!"
The bacteria command center issued another order.

The bacteria squad hurried to the thumb, using shovels to scoop the cream bit by bit, then mixed it with a liquid, loaded it into a big barrel, and carried it onto the truck.

This magical liquid is the best waterproofing material for construction.

[P5] "Little finger crevice discovers sugar! Little finger crevice discovers sugar!" The bacteria command center issues another order.
A small bacteria squad quickly rushes to the little finger. There are many sugar crystals that fell from the cookie.
The sugar is too hard; the bacteria must first crush it with a crusher before loading it onto the truck.
To the bacteria, sugar is extremely precious. It can both replenish energy for the tiny bacteria and serve as a special material for building houses. Of course, some little bacteria even string them up one by one as necklaces to wear, and eat a piece when hungry.

[P6] Look, the cookie cinema is almost finished!
"Hei yo hei! Hei yo hei!"
The little bacteria are all very hardworking, waving hammers and shovels as they work hard.

Beli's hands have many fine lines of different depths—they're the bacteria's highways.
The materials have been collected! The bacteria transport these crumbs, cream, cookie渣, sugar, and various dirt to their headquarters, then start hammering and building all kinds of houses.

[P7] Just then, the heavy rain started pouring down.
"Oh no, Bely is washing his hands!" one little bacterium shouted.
"Don't worry, everyone, quickly hide!" another little bacterium said.
The bacteria quickly hid in the crevices between Bely's fingers or under his fingernails. Bely never cleaned those areas properly, nor did he like to trim his nails, so hiding there was very safe.

Soon the rain stopped. Although some of the building materials were washed away, the bacteria were all fine.
Look, the houses built by the little bacteria were also fine, because the bacteria had waterproofed every house.
"Luckily Bely doesn't like to wash his hands, that's just great!"
The little bacteria loved him for that.

[P8] The bacteria king scratched his head for several nights and finally came up with a bold plan: move the whole family into Belly's stomach!
Belly's stomach is warm, moist, and spacious—perfect for bacteria to live in!
The little bacteria have eaten their fill on Belly's hands, live very comfortably, and their numbers keep growing—there's almost no room left!

[P9] Let's get to work! The bacteria spent a long time making a super-hard, super-big, super-fast truck out of sugar. It can carry many little bacteria at once!
When Billy opened his mouth to eat bread, the bacteria seized the opportunity, drove the truck smoothly from the tip of Billy's finger into his mouth, and slid down the esophagus into Billy's stomach.

[P10] But this party has really hurt BeiLi! Look, his stomach hurts terribly, and his mom is worried and doesn't know what to do.

"Yay! We did it!" the bacteria cheered.
"This place is great! What if we have a wild party?" suggested a small bacterium.
"Great! Awesome!" everyone agreed enthusiastically.
The bacteria bounced, jumped, and drank wildly in BeiLi's stomach, having an absolutely wonderful time.

[P11] Just as the bacteria were having fun, a big pill fell into Belly's stomach. Its strange smell made the little bacteria feel awful. They were in chaos, running and fleeing desperately!

Even worse, the bacterial kingdom built on Belly's hand was also attacked.

"Help!"
"What's going on! Why is Belly still washing his hands!"
"What are these things!"

The heavy rain kept pouring. Water and foam filled the spaces between fingers and under nails. The bacteria had nowhere to hide. In the end, the bacteria and their houses were all flushed down the drain.

The Super Bacteria Kingdom was destroyed.

[P12] Now, every time after using the toilet, before and after meals, or when he gets home, the first thing Béi Lì does is wash his hands clean—he definitely doesn’t want any little bacteria building a super bacteria kingdom on his hands anymore!

Originally, the doctor told him about the bacteria building houses on his hands, gave him medicine, and made him wash his hands properly.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《超级细菌王国》的封面，主题为从小讲卫生，画面中多个卡通细菌形象在黄色背景上进行各种活动，如搬运、挖掘、喊话等，整体风格活泼有趣。
[P2] 贝利吃完甜点后困倦入睡，而他的手上，细菌部队正开始安营扎寨，准备建立超级细菌王国。
[P3] 细菌部队在贝利的手指上发现点心碎屑，指挥中心发出指令，细菌们用工具将碎屑处理后装车，准备用作建造房子的原料。
[P4] 细菌指挥中心发现大拇指下方有奶油，随即派出小分队将其铲下并混合液体，准备作为建筑防水材料使用。
[P5] 细菌指挥中心发现小拇指指缝有砂糖，派出小分队前往收集。由于砂糖太硬，细菌们用破碎机将其打碎后装车，准备用于建造房屋，部分细菌还把砂糖串成项链备用。
[P6] 细菌们在贝利的手上收集完点心碎屑、奶油、砂糖等材料后，开始在大本营里建造各种房子，如饼干电影院和超市，画面中细菌们忙碌地搬运、施工，利用手上的细纹作为高速公路。
[P7] 贝利洗手时，细菌们躲进手指缝和指甲缝中避雨，因贝利不认真清洁这些地方而感到安全；雨停后，细菌们发现房子因做了防水处理而完好无损，庆幸贝利不爱洗手。
[P8] 细菌国王计划将细菌王国迁往贝利的肚子里，因为那里温暖潮湿又宽敞；同时，手上的细菌们因数量激增而感到拥挤。
[P9] 细菌们用砂糖制造了一辆大型卡车，并趁贝利吃面包时，驾驶卡车从手指进入他的嘴巴，沿着食道进入他的肚子里。
[P10] 细菌们成功进入贝利的肚子里，举行狂欢晚会，而贝利因肚子疼难受，妈妈非常焦急。
[P11] 贝利服药后，药片进入胃中，细菌们因气味难忍而惊慌逃窜；同时，贝利洗手导致手上的细菌王国被水和泡沫冲走，最终细菌王国被彻底消灭。
[P12] 贝利在医生的告知和药物治疗后，开始认真洗手，以防止细菌在手上建立王国。
